notice: Project-authored condensed descriptors for every source dimension and score point. Not a verbatim official rubric or validated scoring instrument.

focus_organization.4: Names topic/book and gives a preference with an explanation of why.
focus_organization.3: Names topic/book and states a preference.
focus_organization.2: Topic or preference is unclear or confusing.
focus_organization.1: No named topic/book or stated preference.

conventions.2: Capitalize sentence beginnings and I; allow phonetic spelling of simple words. Errors do not form a systematic pattern.
conventions.1: Errors can obscure meaning; inconsistent capitalization and spelling.

scope_notes: Publication version is not established by the source catalog.
These are classroom descriptors, not a national proficiency standard.
The original permits drawing, dictation and writing. This API supports student-authored text only; it cannot evaluate drawings, handwriting or conventions in adult transcriptions.
total_policy: Display-only unweighted sum; no cross-provider score conversion or proficiency decision.
not_scorable_policy: Source NS row; all scores null. Illegibility cannot be inferred from typed text.
